_doc: 3D models of the MMO (mmo/Assets/Tz/Editor/TzModels.cs). Key — file <key>.glb here, made by tools/models/prepare.py from a generator's model (Tripo). for — what it replaces on the map: building kinds (home — a house one does not enter, house, shop, tavern, hall, barn) or prop kinds (tree, tree-dead, bush, rock, grave, barrel, crates, sign). front — degrees around the vertical that turn the model’s front (its door, Tripo puts it on +Z or −Z) to the street.
